她外表总是一副清冷高傲的模样，冰山般的眼神拒人千里，
却在职业套装下藏着火辣的身躯，前凸后翘的曲线诱人遐想。
我真想撕开那层伪装的假面，
将她压在身下，听她喘息着求饶，彻底融化成一滩春水。

Elsa Babe-140CM-M Pink AHR027 Kaneda Shio-Cool and Aloof Female CEO
She always appears cold and arrogant, her icy eyes keeping everyone at arm's length.
Yet, beneath her business attire lies a fiery body, her curvaceous figure alluring and tempting.
I really want to tear away that mask of pretense,
and pin her down, listening to her gasp and beg for mercy, completely melting into a pool of spring water.
